Il est nécessaire que vous nous fournissiez des informations personnelles en relation avec le programme de développement durable d\'Olam auxquels vous participez. Les données personnelles seront collectées et archivées dans le système OFIS (Sytème d\'Information sur les Planteurs Olam, ou, en anglais, Olam Farmer Information System). Vous avez la possibilité de retirer votre consentement préalablement donné pour la collecte, l\'utilisation et la diffusion de vos données personnelles. Cependant, la non-soumission de vos données et/ou le retrait de votre consentement pourrait vous rendre inapte à participer au programme de développement durable d\'Olam.
Vos données personnelles seront utilisées sur OFIS pour enrichir l\'information sur:

Le logiciel de cartographie. Il est conçu pour représenter graphiquement la plantation et les infrastructures dans leur environnement. Il capitalise les informations relatives aux planteurs liées aux coordonnées cartographiées.

Le logiciel d\'analyse. Il permet de relier les informations personnelles du planteur aux données groupées de son environnement afin d\'aider l\'orientation des programmes. Les utilisateurs OFIS sont en mesure d\'extraire des analyses (ainsi que les données afférentes, telles que les données personnelles des planteurs) sous la forme de rapports en format PDF ou EXCEL. La fonction d\'extraction d\'analyse permet aux utilisateurs d\'identifier spécifiquement des planteurs avec, par exemple, les niveaux de productivité supérieurs ou plus faibles par rapport à leurs plantations dans le programme.

Plans de gestion de plantation. Il s\'agit d\'un plan de gestion individuel et personnalisé établi pour chaque planteur, indiquant les changements à adopter sur la plantation au cours des 3 à 5 prochaines années afin d\'optimiser le potentiel de productivité de chacun.

Conformément au logiciel de cartographie, au logiciel d\'analyse et au plan de gestion de plantation mentionnés dans le paragraphe 2 ci-dessus, les utilisateurs OFIS incluent les employés d\'Olam, le personnel gestionnaire des coopératives, et les clients nationaux et internationaux.

Vos données personnelles dont nous sommes déteneurs seront traitées de manière confidentielle. Néanmoins, elles peuvent être partagées aux utilisateurs OFIS tel que mentionné ci-dessus. Vos données personnelles peuvent être transférées hors de votre juridiction. Le cas échéant, et sous réserve de la loi applicable sur le territoire de transfert, nous prendrons les dispositions nécessaires pour s\'assurer que le standard de protection de vos données personnelles soit comparable au niveau de protection en vigueur dans votre juridiction.

Vous pouvez retirer tout consentement préalablement donné et/ou corriger vos données personnelles et/ou demander plus d\'informations concernant nos politiques et pratiques, en contactant notre responsable de la protection des données à l\'adresse électronique ofis@olamnet.com

We may use and share your personal data as follows
Do you consent? Please tick “✔ “ or “yes”

We may collect Farmer Data to populate ofi related systems where your data can be organized and then analysed to give us important insights such as trends and issues that affect the supply chain as well as improve our services to you and our customers. In order to do so, employees of ofi and its affiliates and certain 3rd-party processors will have access to such ofi-related Systems and your Farmer Data. Your Farmer Data may be shared with our affiliates, partners, and customers.

We may share the Farmer Data you provide us with our customers and partners (who may also share the Farmer Data with their customers and partners) in order to provide insights into where their food is sourced and who is producing it. This transparency allows buyers to make informed and responsible purchasing decisions. These traceability efforts will be shared with the public.

We may use your Farmer Data to do business with you and to help identify opportunities for you to grow your business and operations. When appropriate, we may present you with opportunities to obtain financing, machinery, farm management advice, farm supplies, and insurance, in addition to sales opportunities - all of which will be provided directly by us or a third-party that we refer to you. Accordingly, these third parties will be provided access to your Farmer Data in order to provide these sales and development opportunities to you.

Ofi and its affiliates, which, for the avoidance of doubt, includes including Olam Brands B.V. and ofi customers and partners may use Farmer Data including names, photographs, location information, product information and interviews (if provided) in advertising materials that will be shared publicly, such as on websites, written publications and on products in order to promote purchases of products such as those produced by you and to market our traceability and sustainability initiatives.

We may share your Farmer Data in support of studies by educational, governmental, and non-governmental organisations focused on local farmers, communities, agriculture, supply-chain, traceability, sustainability and related socially conscious studies in order to promote community collaboration and developments in the sustainability and traceability space. Such organisations may use your Farmer Data in their own electronic or published communications.

2. When your Farmer Data is shared with third parties such as our customers and partners in furtherance of the Purpose and the specific uses consented to above, each of these customers and partners are data controllers in their own right and you consent to their use of your data as set forth above in Paragraph 1 and as detailed in the Privacy Statement. Should any of such customers and partners require use of your Farmer Data beyond the Purpose and specific uses consented to above, they may directly contact you to request for your further consent.

You may withdraw consent given, request for access and/or correction of your Farmer Data and/or request for information regarding our policies and practices at any time by contacting us at privacy@ofi.com. While no disclosure requested is obligatory, failure to supply your Farmer Data and/or subsequent withdrawal of your consent may affect our ability to provide certain services that you may have separately requested from us (as the case may be). For example, your address may be required not only to assist with traceability, but also for us to deliver certain materials to you such as farming supplies. In such instances where you revoke consent, we may retain such data in order to fulfil our contractual obligations to you but will not use such data for any other purpose.

Our Farmer Data Privacy Statement is provided for your reference below. It explains how we handle and protect personal data. While your Farmer Data will be shared with the persons indicated above, your Farmer Data that is held by us will be kept confidential and in accordance with applicable privacy laws.

This privacy policy sets forth the modes of collection, utilisation and disclosure of your information gathered on the application. It is supplemental to, and should be read together with the ofi’s Privacy Statement, which explains additional ways we collect and use personal data and is available on www.ofi.com/privacy.html..

It is ofi’s policy to comply with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Ofi will collect and use your data only for specified and legitimate purposes, process it in a manner consistent with such purposes, take reasonable steps to ensure that your data is accurate, complete and kept up-to-date (where necessary) and take appropriate measures to provide adequate protection for your data. 
 Data Controller
 The data controller for your information will be Olam International Limited incorporated in Singapore with company number 199504676H and the relevant affiliated entity in your country or otherwise within the ofi group of companies, as applicable.

 We generally act as the data controller for personal data. However, in certain circumstances, Business Partners may engage us to provide them with certain processing services related to personal data. In such instances, the Business Partner’s collection and use of your personal data is governed by its own privacy policies and we rely on their legal representations that we are authorised to process personal data in the manner they propose or demonstrate.

 As explained above, we will share your personal information for certain specified purposes. Where your personal information is transferred outside the EEA to an ofi affiliate or an entity in a country that is not subject to an adequacy decision by the EU Commission, your personal data will be protected by EU Commission approved cross-border safeguards including standard contractual clauses for cross-border data transfer.
For what purposes do we use your data?
What is our legal basis for collecting and processing your data?

We will only collect and process this data, to conduct our business and pursue our legitimate interests as required by ofi and our affiliates and to comply with legal obligations. We rely on consent for few processing activities (like marketing communication) which can be revoked whenever the data subject requires.
Who will we share this data with?

We may share your data with other members of the ofi group, including any affiliates, to achieve the purposes described above. We will also share your data with government authorities and/or law enforcement officials if mandated by law, and any current and future customers, service providers, suppliers and business partners of ofi in pursuing the purposes described above or otherwise with your consent.
Where will we send your data?

Other than sharing with our third-party processors for the purposes listed above, from time to time your data may be transferred to one of our affiliates in another country. We will take reasonable steps to ensure that your data is adequately protected in accordance with the relevant data protection legislation which resides over processing of data in that country. If you are a farmer based in the EEA, where your personal information is transferred outside the EEA to an affiliate or an entity in a country that is not subject to an adequacy decision by the EU Commission, your personal data will be protected by EU Commission approved cross-border safeguards including standard contractual clauses for cross-border data transfer.
What measures do we have in place to protect your data?

Ofi maintains reasonable safeguards to protect the confidentiality, security and integrity of your data. Although we use security measures to help protect your data against unauthorized disclosure, we cannot guarantee the security of information provided over the internet and will not be responsible for breaches of security beyond our reasonable control.
What rights do you have in relation to your data?

You may choose not to provide data that we request. You have the right to ask ofi for a copy of your data and to verify, correct or restrict active processing of your data. You can ask ofi to stop using your images at any time, in which case it will not be used in future publications but may continue to appear in publications already in circulation. You have the right to make a complaint at any time to the data protection authority in concerned region. These rights may be limited in law. If you wish to exercise these rights or have any questions about them, you can contact ofi at privacy@ofi.com.
How long will you retain my data?

Except as otherwise required by law, ofi will retain your personal data for such period that is necessary for the purposes for which the data was collected. Ofi will share the retention period of your personal data upon your request.
If you have any questions relating to the data we hold about you then please email us at privacy@ofi.com.
